text:
[Council File 22-0014-S2]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
CIVIL RIGHTS, IMMIGRATION, SOCIAL SERVICES, AND NEIGHBORHOODS COMMITTEE REPORT, BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to the acceptance of Round 4 Grant funding from the Office of the Governor’s California Volunteers for Youth Service Corps Employment Program, and adjustments to allocations for the Youth Service Corps Round 3 Grant. A. CIVIL RIGHTS, IMMIGRATION, SOCIAL SERVICES, AND NEIGHBORHOODS COMMITTEE
Recommendation for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
ADOPT the recommendations as detailed in the Communication from Community Investment Department dated October 2, 2026, attached to Council file No. 22-0014-S2.
B. BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. CONCUR with the Civil Rights, Immigration, Social Services and Neighborhoods Committee’s action of October 9, 2026 to approve the recommendations contained in the Community Investment Department (CID) communication and Resolution dated October 2, 2026, attached to the Council file.
2. NOTE and FILE the CID report dated September 3, 2026, attached to the Council file.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the CID. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
